baseline.source: canon: WFB 8e Lizardmen army book (Slann Mage-Priests rule temple-cities through Skink priests, Saurus spawn as the warrior host, isolated by the Old Ones' design)
baseline.why: Lizardmen temple-cities are ruled absolutely by a Slann theocracy with a Saurus warrior caste, isolated, without markets or schooling beyond temple lore

ruined_temple_city.source: canon: WFB 8e Lizardmen / TW:WH3 (Xahutec, Oyxl, Tlanxla, Spektazuma, Tlax and Chupayotl are ruined, sunk or destroyed; Quetza is defiled by Clan Pestilens; Huatl is being refounded; Konquata is not yet founded at the 2502 start)
ruined_temple_city.why: A ruined or unfounded city has lost the temple-schools and a tier of organisation

norse_colony.source: canon: White Dwarf 309 "The Norse of Lustria" (Skeggi founded 888 IC by Losteriksson of the Bjornlings); Norsca tribal package
norse_colony.why: A Norse colony keeps its homeland's jarl-and-warband institutions; Norse settlers keep their chieftains (law_chiefdom, #9037)
